details: For every finite binary concept class, the combinatorial eluder dimension dominates the star number. The half-interval family gives an unbounded separation: $\mathrm{Edim}=n-1$ while star number is 2.
proof: A star witness around a base hypothesis is a sequential eluder witness: every leaf differs from the base at its own point and agrees with it at all earlier star points.
proof_source: Theorem 8 (the star-number lower bound) of Li--Kamath--Foster--Srebro.
name: Combinatorial Eluder Dimension / Star Number
